name: My Adorable Demon Story
detailed_description:
My Adorable Demon story is a pet-care simulation with multiple endings. Bathe, feed, and bond with a demon lord trapped in a plush toy. Will you restore his power… or drive him into madness? You have 30 days to shape his fate and maybe win his twisted heart.

Story

Play as the protagonist, a young woman who loves dolls and plushies, who finds a dirty plush toy on her way home. After cleaning and dressing it up, she places it in her dollhouse, where she has all kinds of accessories for it. To her surprise, she discovers that the plush toy is alive—and is none other than a demon!

Now that she has awakened the demon, a curse is unleashed, and she has 30 days to shape both her destiny and his.

Darian

Darian, a demon lord trapped in the body of a plushie, has lost all his powers. As you nurture his body and heart, he will gradually recover his abilities. Despite his situation, he maintains his confident personality.

As you get to know him, you'll be able to grow or soften his dark side.

Features

  • Plan your days: You have 12 hours each day to choose activities that affect his mood and shape the story. Every decision counts.

  • Dress him up: Choose his daily outfit based on his preferences. The right clothing might bring you closer or reveal something unexpected.

  • Play mini-games: He might enjoy playing—but are you sure that's best for him?

  • Pet him: Discover how he reacts when you pet his head!

  • Make meaningful choices: Your decisions influence his emotional development and lead to different destinies.

  • Customize his home: Decorate his room to your liking—or perhaps to his?

  • Unlock multiple endings: Your actions shape his fate. Will you heal his heart, win his love, or lead him to madness?
